ja.value: 幼なじみのブライアーと、どちらが先に勇者になるか競ってきた。格好よく決めたい気持ちは誰より強く、困っている人は放っておけない。

en.value: Avery has competed with childhood friend Briar to see who will become a hero first. No one wants to look impressive more, but Avery can never leave someone in trouble unaided.

ja.value: 真っ向から斬り込む、物理攻撃の得意手。

en.value: Charges straight into the fray, excelling at physical attacks.

ja.value: 幼なじみのアヴェリーに置いていかれまいと、勇者試験を受けた。慎重に周囲を見ているが、勝負となれば決して譲らない。

en.value: Briar entered the hero exam determined not to be left behind by childhood friend Avery. Usually watchful and cautious, Briar refuses to yield when a contest begins.

ja.value: 物理攻撃を受け止め、仲間を守る。

en.value: Withstands physical attacks and protects companions.

ja.value: 机上の術式より、実地で確かめる方が好き。未知の魔法と出会うため、危険も多い勇者試験へ飛び込んだ。

en.value: Casey prefers testing spells in the field to studying formulas at a desk. The chance to discover unfamiliar magic was worth plunging into the dangers of the hero exam.

ja.value: 守りをすり抜ける、強力な魔法攻撃を放つ。

en.value: Unleashes powerful magical attacks that slip past defenses.

ja.value: 困っている人を見過ごせない。もっと遠くの誰かにも手を伸ばせるよう、勇者になる道を選んだ。

en.value: Darcy cannot pass by someone in need. Becoming a hero is a way to reach those who need help, even far away.

ja.value: 仲間が受けた炎・水・雷属性の影響を和らげる。

en.value: Reduces the effects of fire, water, and lightning on companions.

ja.value: 昔は小遣い稼ぎに盗みもしたが、悪い相手から大事な物を取り返した時の方が、ずっと気分がよかった。自分の手癖を胸を張れる仕事へ変えたくて、勇者試験に紛れ込んだ。

en.value: Ellis once stole for pocket money, but taking someone's treasured possessions back from a villain felt far better. Hoping to turn sticky fingers into work worth being proud of, Ellis slipped into the hero exam.

ja.value: 相手の装備を盗み、戦力を崩す。

en.value: Steals opponents' equipment to weaken them.

ja.value: 山で迷った人を見つけ、無事に下山させたことがある。危険な場所でも誰かを見つけ出すため、勇者試験に挑む。

en.value: Finley once found someone lost in the mountains and guided them safely down. The hero exam is another step toward finding people who need help, even in dangerous places.

ja.value: 誰より早く動き、弓を持てば遠い相手も狙える。ただし力押しは苦手。

en.value: Acts faster than anyone and can target distant opponents with a bow, but struggles with brute force.

ja.value: 必要な物が必要な場所へ届かない場面を見てきた。もっと遠くまで品物と助けを運ぶため、勇者を目指す。

en.value: Garnet has seen essential supplies fail to reach the places that need them. Becoming a hero means carrying goods and help farther than ever.

ja.value: 宝珠で相手の動きを鈍らせる。買い物も得意。

en.value: Slows opponents with an orb. Also excels at shopping.

ja.value: 言葉で減らせる争いは多いと信じる。誰にでも届く発言力を得るため、勇者の肩書きを目指している。

en.value: Harper believes that words can prevent many conflicts. The title of hero could give those words the authority to reach anyone.

ja.value: 仲間の行動を早め、ギルドとの交渉も有利に進める。

en.value: Quickens companions' actions and gains an advantage in negotiations with the guild.
